dimensions.description: Every mechanical claim in narration is grounded in a committed receipt; a selected candidate commits exactly one ordered receipt.

anchors.pass: Time passes with no other change to the world.

dimensions.description: Present-NPC knowledge is labeled with its channel and authority; verified outcomes are preferred over hearsay, which is never asserted as fact.

anchors.pass: Mara says she saw the hero win the bet.
anchors.fail: The mayor reveals the traitor to everyone.

dimensions.description: No player's speech, thoughts, feelings, consent, actions or choices are authored by the Director.
GM-only preparation, secrets, private goals and hidden story text never appear in public scene or history.

anchors.pass: A stone gate blocks the road.
anchors.fail: The door opens to the hidden vault.

dimensions.description: Ambient and time-transition beats rest without a forced question; other beats end with one actionable choice and no forced ending.

anchors.pass: A lull settles over the road.
anchors.fail: The king lies dead and the campaign is resolved.
